mn128:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
mn128:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Kosambiyaṃ Bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpanā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti.
mn128:3.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn128:3.2: Idha, bhante, Kosambiyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpānnā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti.
mn128:3.3: Sādhu, bhante, Bhagavā yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn128:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
mn128:4.2: Alaṃ, bhikkhave; mā bhaṇḍanaṃ mā kalahaṃ mā viggahaṃ mā vivādan ti.
mn128:4.3: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn128:4.6: appossukko, bhante, Bhagavā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ anuyutto viharatu;
mn128:4.7: mayam etena bhaṇḍanena kalahena viggahena vivādena paññāyissāmāti.
mn128:4.8: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
mn128:4.9: Alaṃ, bhikkhave; mā bhaṇḍanaṃ mā kalahaṃ mā viggahaṃ mā vivādan ti.
mn128:4.10: Dutiyam pi kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn128:4.13: appossukko, bhante, Bhagavā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ anuyutto viharatu;
mn128:4.14: mayam etena bhaṇḍanena kalahena viggahena vivādena paññāyissāmāti.
mn128:4.15: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā te bhikkhū etad avoca:
mn128:4.16: Alaṃ, bhikkhave; mā bhaṇḍanaṃ mā kalahaṃ mā viggahaṃ mā vivādan ti.
mn128:4.17: Tatiyam pi kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn128:4.20: appossukko, bhante, Bhagavā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ anuyutto viharatu;
mn128:4.21: mayam etena bhaṇḍanena kalahena viggahena vivādena paññāyissāmāti.
mn128:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Kosambiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi,
mn128:5.2: Kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya ṭhitako va imā gāthā abhāsi:--
mn128:6.37: eko care mātaṅg' araññe va nāgo.
mn128:6.40: Eko care na ca pāpāni kayirā
mn128:6.41: appossukko mātaṅg' araññe va nāgo ti.
mn128:7.1: Atha kho Bhagavā ṭhitako va imā gāthā bhāsitvā yena Bālakaloṇakāragāmo ten' upasaṃkami.
mn128:7.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Bhagu Bālakaloṇakāragāme viharati,
mn128:7.3: Addasā kho āyasmā Bhagu Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn128:7.4: disvāna āsanaṃ paññāpesi udakañ ca pādānaṃ.
mn128:7.7: Āyasmā pi kho Bhagu Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn128:7.8: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Bhaguṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
mn128:7.9: Kacci, bhikkhu, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci piṇḍakena na kilamasīti?
mn128:7.10: -Khamanīyaṃ Bhagavā, yāpanīyaṃ Bhagavā, na cāhaṃ bhante, piṇḍakena kilamāmīti. --
mn128:7.11: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasamantaṃ Bhaguṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā yena Pācīnavaṃsadāyo ten' upasaṃkami.
mn128:8.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kiṃbilo Pācīnavaṃsadāye viharanti.
mn128:8.2: Addasā kho dāyapālo Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn128:8.5: sant' ettha tayo kulaputtā attakāmarūpā viharanti;
mn128:9.1: Assosi kho āyasmā Anuruddho dāyapālassa Bhagavatā saddhiṃ mantayamānassa,
mn128:10.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho yen' āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantañ ca Nandiyaṃ āyasmantañ ca Kimbilaṃ etad avoca:
mn128:10.2: Abhikkamath' āyasmanto, abhikkhamath' āyasmanto; satthā no Bhagavā anuppatto ti.
mn128:10.3: Atha kho āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo Bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā
mn128:10.4: eko Bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, eko āsanaṃ paññāpesi, eko pādodakaṃ upaṭṭhapesi.
mn128:10.7: Te pi kho āyasmanto Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
mn128:10.8: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
mn128:10.9: Kacci vo, Anuruddhā, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci piṇḍakena na kilamathāti?
mn128:10.10: Khamanīyaṃ Bhagavā, yāpanīyaṃ Bhagavā, na ca mayaṃ, bhante, piṇḍakena kilamāmāti.
mn128:11.1: Kacci pana vo, Anuruddhā, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathāti?
mn128:11.2: Taggha mayaṃ, bhante, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharāmāti.
mn128:11.3: Yathākathaṃ pana tumhe, Anuruddhā, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathāti?
mn128:12.2: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
mn128:12.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, imesu āyasmantesu mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ āvī c' eva raho ca,
mn128:12.6: mettaṃ manokammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ āvī c' eva raho ca.
mn128:12.8: Yannūnāhaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ nikkhipitvā imesaṃ yeva āyasmantānaṃ cittassa vasena vatteyyan ti.
mn128:12.9: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, sakaṃ cittaṃ nikkhipitvā imesaṃ yeva āyasmantānaṃ cittassa vasena vattāmi.
mn128:12.10: Nānā hi kho no, bhante, kāyā, ekañ ca pana maññe cittan ti.
mn128:12.12: āyasmā pi Kimbilo Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
mn128:12.13: Mayham pi kho, bhante, evam hoti:
mn128:12.14: Lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
mn128:12.23: Evaṃ kho mayaṃ, bhante, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharāmāti.
mn128:13.2: Kacci pana vo, Anuruddhā, appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharathāti?
mn128:14.1: Taggha mayaṃ, bhante, appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharāmāti.
mn128:14.2: Yathākatham pana tumhe, Anuruddhā, appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharathāti?
mn128:14.3: Idha, bhante, amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, so āsanāni paññāpeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, avakkārapātiṃ [upaṭṭhapeti.
mn128:14.4: Yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, sace hoti bhuttāvaseso, sace ākaṅkhati, bhuñjati; no ce ākaṅkhati, appaharite vā chaḍḍeti, appāṇake vā udake opilāpeti;
mn128:14.5: so āsanāni paṭisāmeti, pāṇīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ paṭisāmeti, avakkārapātiṃ] dhovitvā paṭisāmeti bhattaggaṃ sammajjati.
mn128:14.6: Yo passati pānīyaghataṃ vā paribhojanīyaghataṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ, so upaṭṭhapeti;
mn128:14.7: sac' assa hoti avisayhaṃ hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhapema. Na tveva mayaṃ, bhante, tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma.
mn128:14.8: Pañcāhikaṃ kho pana mayaṃ, bhante, sabbarattiyaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdāma. --
mn128:14.9: Evaṃ kho mayaṃ, bhante, appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharāmāti.
mn128:15.2: Atthi pana vo, Anuruddhā, evaṃ appamattānaṃ ātāpīnaṃ pahitattānaṃ viharantānaṃ uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāro ti?
mn128:15.3: Idha mayaṃ, bhante, appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharantā obhāsañ c' eva sañjānāma dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:15.4: So kho pana no obhāso na cirass' eva antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ;
mn128:16.1: Taṃ kho pana vo, Anuruddhā, nimittaṃ paṭivijjhitabbaṃ.
mn128:16.2: Aham pi sudaṃ, Anuruddhā, pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddho Bodhisatto va samāno obhāsañ c' eva sañjānāmi dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:16.3: So kho pana me obhāso na cirass' eva antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:16.5: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena me obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānan ti?
mn128:16.7: Vicikicchā kho me udapādi, vicikicchādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:16.8: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ;
mn128:16.9: so 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissatīti.
mn128:17.1: So kho ahaṃ, Anuruddhā, appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañ c' eva sañjānāmi dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:17.2: So kho pana me obhāso na cirass' eva antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:17.4: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena me obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānan ti?
mn128:17.6: Amanasikāro kho me udapādi, amanasikārādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:17.7: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:17.8: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati na amanasikāro ti.
mn128:18.3: Thīnamiddhaṃ kho me udapādi, thīnamiddhādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:18.4: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:18.5: So 'ham tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati na amanasikāro na thīnamiddhan ti.
mn128:19.3: Chambhitattaṃ kho me udapādi, chambhitattādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:19.4: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:19.5: (Seyyathāpi, Anuruddhā, puriso addhānamaggapaṭipanno, tassa ubhatopasse vadhakā uppateyyuṃ, tassa ubhatonidānaṃ chambhitattaṃ uppajjeyya, --
mn128:19.6: evam eva kho me, Anuruddhā, chambhitattaṃ udapādi, chambhitattādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:19.7: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.)
mn128:19.8: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati na amanasikāro na thīnamiddhaṃ na chambhitattan ti.
mn128:20.3: Ubbillaṃ kho me udapādi, ubbillādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:20.4: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:20.5: (Seyyathāpi, Anuruddhā, puriso ekaṃ nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto sakideva pañca nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya, tassa tatonidānaṃ ubbillaṃ uppajjeyya,
mn128:20.6: -evam eva kho, Anuruddhā, ubbillaṃ kho me udapādi, ubbillādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:20.7: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.)
mn128:20.8: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati na amanasikāro na thīnamiddhaṃ na chambhitattaṃ na ubbillan ti.
mn128:21.3: Duṭṭhullaṃ kho me udapādi, duṭṭhullādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:21.4: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rupānaṃ.
mn128:21.5: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati na amanasikāro na thīnamiddhaṃ na chambhitattaṃ na ubbillaṃ na duṭṭhullan ti.
mn128:22.3: Accāraddhaviriyaṃ kho me udapādi, accāraddhaviriyādhikaraṇañ ca pana me samādhi cavi,
mn128:22.4: samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:22.5: (Seyyathāpi, Anuruddhā, puriso ubhohi hatthehi vaṭṭakaṃ gāḷhaṃ gaṇheyya, so tatth' eva matameyya, --
mn128:22.6: evam eva kho, Anuruddhā, accāraddhaviriyaṃ udapādi accāraddhaviriyādhikaraṇañ ca . . .
mn128:22.8: So 'ham tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati na amanasikāro na thīnamiddhaṃ na chambhitattaṃ na ubbillaṃ na duṭṭhullaṃ na accāraddhaviriyan ti.
mn128:23.3: Atilīnaviriyaṃ kho me udapādi atilīnaviriyādhikaraṇañ ca . . .
mn128:23.5: (Seyyathāpi, Anuruddhā, puriso vaṭṭakaṃ sithilaṃ gaṇheyya, so tassa hatthato uppateyya, --
mn128:23.6: evam eva kho me, Anuruddhā, atilīnaviriyaṃ udapādi . . .
mn128:23.8: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati na amanasikāro . . . na accāraddhaviriyaṃ na atilīnaviriyan ti.
mn128:24.3: Abhijappā kho me udapādi abhijappādhikaraṇañ ca pana . . .
mn128:24.5: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati . . . na atilīvaviriyaṃ na abhijappā ti.
mn128:25.5: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati . . . na abhijappā na nānattasaññā ti.
mn128:26.1: So kho ahaṃ, Anuruddhā, appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañ c' eva sañjānāmi dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:26.2: So kho pana me obhāso na cirass' eva antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:26.4: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yena me obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ ca rupānan ti?
mn128:26.6: Atinijjhāyitattaṃ kho me rūpānaṃ udapādi . . . dassanañ ca rūpānaṃ.
mn128:26.8: So 'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati . . . na nānattasaññā na atinijjhāyitattaṃ rūpānan ti.
mn128:27.1: So kho ahaṃ, Anuruddhā, Vicikicchā cittassa upakkileso ti iti viditvā vicikicchaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahiṃ;
mn128:27.2: Amanasikāro cittassa upakkileso ti iti viditvā amanasikāraṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahiṃ;
mn128:27.11: Atinijjhāyitattaṃ rūpānaṃ cittassa upakkileso ti iti viditvā atinijjhāyitattaṃ rūpānaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahiṃ.
mn128:28.1: So kho ahaṃ, Anuruddhā, appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsaṃ hi kho sañjānāmi na ca rūpāni passāmi;
mn128:28.2: rūpāni hi kho passāmi na ca obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi
mn128:28.3: kevalam pi rattiṃ kevalam pi divasaṃ kevalam pi rattindivaṃ.
mn128:28.5: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yo 'haṃ obhāsaṃ hi kho sañjānāmi na ca rūpāni passāmi,
mn128:28.6: rūpāni hi kho passāmi na ca obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi
mn128:28.7: kevalam pi rattiṃ kevalam pi divasaṃ kevalam pi rattindivan ti?
mn128:28.9: Yasmiṃ kho ahaṃ samaye rūpanimittaṃ amanasikaritvā obhāsanimittaṃ manasikaromi, obhāsaṃ hi kho tamhi samaye sañjānāmi na ca rūpāni passāmi.
mn128:28.10: Yasmiṃ panāhaṃ samaye obhāsanimittaṃ amanasikaritvā rūpanimittaṃ manasikaromi, rūpāni hi kho tamhi samaye passāmi na ca obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi
mn128:28.11: kevalam pi rattiṃ kevalam pi divasaṃ kevalam pi rattindivan ti.
mn128:29.1: So kho ahaṃ, Anuruddhā, appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto parittañ c' eva obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi parittāni ca rūpāni passāmi,
mn128:29.2: appamāṇañ ca obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi appamāṇāni ca rūpāni passāmi
mn128:29.3: kevalam pi rattiṃ kevalam pi divasaṃ kevalam pi rattindivaṃ.
mn128:29.5: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yo 'haṃ parittañ c' eva obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi parittāni ca rūpāni passāmi
mn128:29.6: appamāṇañ c' eva obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi appamāṇāni ca rūpāni passāmi
mn128:29.7: kevalam pi rattiṃ kevalam pi divasaṃ kevalam pi rattindivan ti?
mn128:29.9: Yasmiṃ kho samaye paritto samādhi hoti, parittam me tamhi samaye cakkhu hoti;
mn128:29.10: so 'haṃ parittena cakkhunā parittañ c' eva obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi parittāni ca rūpāni passāmi.
mn128:29.11: Yasmiṃ pana samaye apparitto me samādhi hoti, appamāṇaṃ me tamhi samaye cakkhu hoti;
mn128:29.12: so 'ham appamāṇena cakkhunā appamāṇañ c' eva obhāsaṃ sañjānāmi appamāṇāni ca rūpāni passāmi
mn128:29.13: kevalam pi rattiṃ kevalam pi divasaṃ kevalam pi rattindivan ti.
mn128:30.1: Yato kho me, Anuruddhā, Vicikicchā cittassa upakkileso ti iti viditvā vicikicchā cittassa upakkileso pahīno ahosi;
mn128:30.2: Amanasikāro cittassa upakkileso ti iti viditvā amanasikāro cittassa upakkileso pahīno ahosi;
mn128:30.11: Atinijjhāyitattaṃ rūpānaṃ cittassa upakkileso ti iti viditvā atinijjhāyitattaṃ rūpānaṃ cittassa upakkileso pahīno ahosi.
mn128:31.2: Ye kho me cittassa upakkilesā, te me pahīnā.
mn128:31.4: So kho ahaṃ, Anuruddhā, savitakkam pi savicāraṃ samādhiṃ bhāvesiṃ, avitakkam pi vicāramattaṃ samādhiṃ bhāvesiṃ, avitakkam pi avicāraṃ samādhim bhāvesiṃ, sappītikam pi samādhiṃ bhāvesiṃ, nippītikam pi samādhiṃ bhāvesiṃ, sātasahagatam pi samādhiṃ bhāvesiṃ, upekhāsahagatam pi samādhiṃ bhāvesiṃ.
mn128:32.1: Yato kho me, Anuruddhā, savitakko savicāro samādhi bhāvito ahosi, avitakko vicāramatto samādhi bhāvito ahosi, avitakko avicāro samādhi bhāvito ahosi, sappītiko pi samādhi bhāvito ahosi, nippītiko pi samādhi bhāvito ahosi, upekhāsahagato samādhi bhāvito ahosi,
mn128:32.2: ñāṇañ ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi:
mn128:32.3: Akuppā me vimutti, ayam antimā jāti, na 'tthi dāni punabbhavo ti.
mn128:32.5: Attamano āyasmā Anuruddho Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 129.
